title: Dimension-free bounds for Riesz transforms on the Hamming cube via a Bellman function
summary: We give a Bellman-function proof of the dimension-free estimate \[ \Big\| \vec{R} f \Big\|_{L^p(Ω;\,\ell^2)} \lesssim (p-1) \,\|f\|_{L^p(Ω)}, \qquad 2\le p<\infty, \] for the vector of Riesz transforms associated with the Walsh number operator on the Hamming cube $Ω=\{-1,1\}^n$, as well as for locally compact abelian groups, in particular $Ω=\mathbb{Z}^n$. The argument is based on a Poisson semigroup representation, symmetrized estimates along edges of $Ω$, and a two-point inequality.
